traits.title: Single-Expression Body
traits.description: cube.py is one expression spanning 53 lines, with lambdas nested inside a single dictionary literal.

traits.title: Standard-Library Imports
traits.description: cube.py imports functools, math, ctypes and time, all from the Python standard library.

traits.title: Two-Module Layout
traits.description: The repository holds only two source files, cube.py and shadecube.py, with no other Python modules.

character.originStory: The Spincubus is found on a Windows desktop, where it draws a rotating cube in thin wireframe lines. It feeds on the clock, reading time and math with every turn. Its body is one unbroken expression, stretched over fifty-three lines, and a glowing filament runs through every fold of it. Field notes record no README, so no naturalist has learned its habits from a manual. Its companion, shadecube.py, lives in the same clearing, but the Spincubus has never been seen shading a single face. It spins on, faithful to one line.
